project_info.title: Aura Harmony - Çocuklar İçin Modern Müzik Okulu
project_info.context: A modern, warm, highly legible children's music school website in Turkish. Light color palette, expressive editorial typography, playful yet refined kinetic animations.

typography.font_pairings: Outfit (Headings) + Plus Jakarta Sans (Body) + Caveat (Playful Hand-written Annotations)

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight leading-snug
scale.caption: text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-widest font-semibold text-amber-600

colors.gradient_usage: Strictly light glass or subtle 5% radial highlights. No harsh full-screen tech gradients.

layout_and_spacing.hero_height: min-h-[90vh] flex flex-col justify-center relative overflow-hidden
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: MODE A: TETRIS & BENTO MESH (Asymmetric, wide gap-8 to gap-12)

sections_breakdown.name: Kinetic Hero
sections_breakdown.description: Bold masked line-by-line reveal animation on load. Playful badge, warm children music background illustration or photo with low opacity overlay, floating animated musical notes micro-canvas, direct CTA to call/email.

sections_breakdown.name: Editorial Marquee Ribbon
sections_breakdown.description: Slow, organic running ribbon displaying school mottos: 'Notalarla Büyüyen Özgüven • Eğlenceli Solfej • Küçük Eller Dev Melodiler • Birebir Eğitici Yaklaşım'.

sections_breakdown.name: Hakkımızda & Manifesto Chapters
sections_breakdown.description: 4 numbered editorial manifesto chapters explaining school methodology: 01. Oyunla Müzik Algısı, 02. Bireysel İlgi & Ritim, 03. Sahne Özgüveni, 04. Sanatla Büyüyen Zeka.

sections_breakdown.name: Dersler & Enstrümanlar
sections_breakdown.description: Showcase of instrument classes (Piyano, Gitar, Keman, Bateri, Şan & Solfej, Orff Ritim Atölyesi) with age groups (4-6 yaş, 7-12 yaş, 13+ yaş), skills gained, interactive audio preview toggle simulation.

sections_breakdown.name: Uzman Eğitmenlerimiz
sections_breakdown.description: Interactive grid of warm teacher profiles with instrument specialization, conservatoire background, child psychology approach & quote.

sections_breakdown.name: Okulumuzdan Anlar (Galeri)
sections_breakdown.description: Interactive photo gallery mosaic with category filter (Sınıf İçi, Konser & Recital, Atölyeler, Neşeli Anlar).

sections_breakdown.name: İletişim & Ulaşım
sections_breakdown.description: Clear display of phone number (+90 531 102 60 85) and email (bilgi@muzikokulumuz.com) with one-click copy buttons, studio address, visiting hours, and transport info. NO forms needed as per user choice.

motion_and_interactions.hero_animation: Masked line reveal with staggerChildren: 0.15s, drop-in badges, subtle float on floating icons
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Viewport enter animation (y: 30 to 0, opacity 0 to 1, transition 0.6s easeOut)
motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: Card lift hover (-translate-y-2), glow ring, scale-105 on teacher photos
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Copy-to-clipboard toast notification via sonner, sound wave bar visualizer animation

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the website using single-page navigation with smooth scrolling links to section IDs (#anasayfa, #hakkimizda, #dersler, #egitmenler, #galeri, #iletisim).
Keep header background semi-opaque with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/85 border-b border-amber-100/60) with z-50.
Implement Turkish copy with high emotional warmth, tailored to parents wanting music education for their children.
Ensure every interactive button/link/card has a valid data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
Use framer-motion for kinetic hero text reveal, lesson filter tabs, teacher modal/hover effect, and sonner for interactive quick-copy toast notifications.
Do not render any contact submission form. Provide rich direct action buttons (Copy Email, Copy Phone, Call Now, Send Email) with visual feedback.

testing_attributes.navbar_links: data-testid='nav-link-anasayfa', data-testid='nav-link-hakkimizda', data-testid='nav-link-dersler', data-testid='nav-link-egitmenler', data-testid='nav-link-galeri', data-testid='nav-link-iletisim'
